title: Reliving The Moment
description: A mod made to somewhat rebalance  totems by adding extra steps to be able to use them.
body:
A mod made to somewhat rebalance totems by adding extra steps to be able to use them.

Adds Wretchleather, a new material gained from killing Evokers. Using that a Wretchleather Belt can be made, with which the player can use Totems, it also being the only way to use Totems. The Belt acts as a Bundle, being able to store 3 Totems. To use Totems the Player needs to equip the Belt inside the Trinkets Belt slot. Upon Totem trigger the Player is subjected with a minute of Soul Debt, an effect that acts as a cooldown, making Totems more of a last resort then an active part of the fight. The Mod also weakens Totems by stripping them down to only applying lite absorption, regeneration and completly removing fire immunity from the effect list.
